lines.text: The Spirit says some will abandon the faith in later times and prohibit marriage and require abstinence from certain foods.
Everything God created is good, and nothing received with thanksgiving should be rejected, because the word of God and prayer sanctify it.
Paul tells Timothy to reject silly myths and train himself for wisdom, which holds promise for the present life and the next.
Timothy should set an example in speech, conduct, love, faith and purity, and devote himself to the public reading of Scripture.
Timothy received his gift through a prophecy spoken at the laying on of hands by the apostles.
